root_cause.text: During out-of-place decryption in the `authencesn` IPsec protocol implementation, the `crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt` function attempts to write the high-order sequence bits to the destination buffer (`dst`) at offset `assoclen + cryptlen`, which exceeds the allocated size of the destination buffer and causes an out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the operation `scatterwalk_map_and_copy(tmp + 1, dst, assoclen + cryptlen, 4, 1);` is restricted to the in-place decryption scenario (`src == dst`). For out-of-place decryption (`src != dst`), the offset is adjusted to `assoclen + cryptlen - 4` to prevent writing past the end of the destination buffer.
